- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended must-see attractions include Arches National Park, Canyonlands National Park, Dead Horse Point State Park, and Downtown Moab.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested top trails include Delicate Arch Trail, Chesler Park Trail, Fisher Towers Trail, Grandstaff Canyon Trail, and Slickrock Trail.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested best times to visit Moab are spring (March to May) and fall (September to November) for mild temperatures and fewer crowds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable events include the Easter Jeep Safari, Moab Off-Road, Arches-Canyonlands Science Festival, Moab Music Festival, Moab Folk Festival, and Moab WinterFest.
